name: Auth0
about: A hosted customer identity service from Okta for adding sign-in, sign-up and access control to applications.

facts.note: There is a Free plan as well as paid plans.
Public Cloud is a shared multi-tenant deployment; Private Cloud is a dedicated instance on AWS or Azure.

Mapped from the SDK cards (.NET, Flutter, Go, Java, JavaScript and Node, Kotlin Multiplatform, PHP, Python, Ruby, Auth0.swift); TypeScript isn't named. The HTTPS Authentication and Management APIs are documented at https://auth0.com/docs/api.
Audited yearly for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2; a BAA is given on request, but not for Azure deployments. PCI DSS environments are offered with no level stated, so not recorded as Level 1.
